tools.name: diagnose_error
tools.description: Diagnose existing EXTERNAL execution feedback for inline Python/Java source. Returns repair guidance and a retrieval decision; does not execute source or perform retrieval.

tools.name: execute_and_diagnose
tools.description: Execute one Main.py/Main.java file against a fixed nonempty STDIO suite and diagnose failures. All required v1 workflow, problem, code and tests fields must be supplied.

tools.name: check_syntax
tools.description: Check syntax/compilation of one Main.py/Main.java file. Does not run tests and cannot establish test success.
